accounting.allowanceBasis: Five cents per maximum admission is an explicit proposed uncertainty allowance, not a published endpoint price.

pricing.interpretation: Existing portfolioRoute already reserves against the cache-write input rate. Prices and account availability must be rechecked at final authorization; unknown count/retrieval billing is not a zero-cost fact.

route.verificationLimit: A serialized request proves requested settings. Returned model/tier and usage establish only the fields actually observed; no hidden reasoning behavior or immutable snapshot is inferred.

includedCodex.requirements: A verified isolated route with truthful subscription/access accounting, no worker-readable account secrets, exact model/settings observations, and equivalent durable request/authority binding. No undocumented auth proxy or native-host fallback.

timeAndPeople.activeWallEnforcement: Must be enforced by the final coordinator; current protocol fields alone do not enforce a whole-release wall limit.
timeAndPeople.note: Proposed attention allowances, not measured effort or scheduled people. No judge-model allowance is hidden in the provider budget. Human fees need a separate explicit amount if requested.

experiment.orderPolicy: Custodian predeclares one reproducible randomized order before run; no outcome-conditioned ordering or reruns.
experiment.mainEstimand: Product/configuration comparison. The MIDAS comparator preserves its procedure but is ported to the verified shared executor; this is not the unchanged historical Windows implementation.
experiment.historicalToolGap: Historical MIDAS did not advertise adaptive acquisition. New acquisition/tool availability must be listed by arm. Differing tools prevent attribution solely to orchestration.
experiment.isolatedOrchestrationCondition: A separate common-tool comparison would equip every arm with the same verified tools and label the migrated prior arm explicitly. It is a replacement design requiring a newly frozen manifest within an approved schedule, not an extra funded run or an unchanged historical baseline.
experiment.fundedAblation: Full workflow with versus without acquired memory; this does not isolate every change in orchestration or prompt projection.
experiment.historicalPrompt: Owner supplied original Fable prompt in the conversation; exact imported bytes and historical connectors/settings remain unverified. Historical outputs are contextual references only.
experiment.independentAssessmentRequirement: Trusted separately controlled assessor key and a signed receipt bound to exact candidate, cases, conditions and output hashes. Producer-written independent=true does not qualify.
experiment.claimLimit: One exploratory run per arm is not statistical superiority, customer validation, general worker qualification or demonstrated profit.
experiment.transferBinding: Current importCandidate/reuse requires the same business. Use a new service task/source context within each arm's explicitly synthetic sandbox business. This is cross-task/domain fit, not cross-business material transfer; a second business remains nonreuse absent a separately authorized transfer path.
experiment.adoptionBoundary: Full-workflow memory ablation does not automatically fit a procedure-only adoption API. Do not invent changed procedure hashes or promote from a favorable report.

authority.allowedData: Public sources and explicitly labeled synthetic business/case inputs only; no private owner/customer access is inferred.
authority.dynamicWork: Additional model parents, new tasks, new tools/hosts, new effects, changed model settings and reserve transfers have zero admission until separately bound and explicitly authorized.

localScope.acquisitionUrls: Selected and source-bound by the independent job manifest; no query, fragment, credentials, redirects or private destination.
localScope.rule: Current ExecutorPolicy has file/output/time settings, not a demonstrated whole-task aggregate memory/pids/disk guarantee. Require verified aggregate limits or fail closed before live commands. Final grants must bind actual installed policy and host list.

existingInterfaces.reuse: One fixed business journey, one OperatingModels ledger, discovery6/analysis1/planner1, task graph and exact correction reserve. Existing loader profiles enumerate legacy local tools; adaptive task profiles need exact fresh binding.
Pre-observed business evidence and finite outcome graph; current profile minimums functional-project7 and other families3. Minimum is not a credible complex-work budget.
Shared plan/adaptive task contracts, functional-project and response-packet work, current artifact-bound correction and deterministic checks.
Existing execution loop; coordinator must not invent an untracked parallel model loop.
Signed OperatingGrant, exact request bytes/count/admission, business/stage allocations, concurrency1, durable same-ID recovery and provisional accounting.
Prepared three-arm conditions and protected-context projection receipt only; not a live runner.
Existing exact two-arm one-response slots, not a full-workflow or three-arm adapter. Do not relabel its eight slots as eight executed workflows.
Independent output-bound assessment, scoped candidate eligibility/adoption and retained baseline. New trial coordinator must provide actual outputs and cannot self-sign assessor trust.

manifestFields: stage IDs and immutable job manifests
resource allocations and stage/whole-release wall budgets
dependency and allowed same-arm memory hashes
rubric and independently controlled assessor trust
exact request bytes/hash written before admission
constraints: Only existing shared controller and verified adapters dispatch work.
Persist stages and task/attempt IDs before admission; cross-process whole-release concurrency1.
Allocate new grants disjointly; a coordinator must not reset spending by loading another ledger.
Never mint live authority from this proposal, a UI task mandate or historical unsigned grant.
Each stage can consume only its own allocation; unused cap expires.
Preflight must prove task tool/action finishing floor fits its assigned cap; revise an infeasible schedule before signing, never grade a budget-starved smoke as completion.
Admit no trial until all arm jobs and rubric are bound independently; paid dispatch remains closed on missing adapter, case, assessor or policy.
Freeze whole loaded implementation and exact tool profiles, including adaptive source; OperatingModels' narrower implementation hash alone is insufficient.
Unknown creation or command effect holds its reservation and lease; resume only persisted response/operation identity, no fresh replay.
Port historical procedure to shared executor with explicit migration manifest; keep product-comparison and common-tool estimands distinct.

preflight: Complete current engineering and regression/browser/persistence checks with no provider calls.
Independently review containment, credential boundary, acquisition policy, aggregate resources, cancellation and unknown-effect replay.
Freeze source tree/tool profiles/executor runtime and recompute every binding; hashes stay null in this version.
Supply independent cases/rubric and named assessor; no developer fixture may be called protected.
Prepare exact reviewable unsigned subgrants with disjoint caps that sum to this proposal; verify shared whole-release concurrency and accounting.
Verify project/model availability and route without granting worker access to account secrets; any paid probe is charged to development, never extra.
Obtain one consolidated owner decision on the exact final packets, Max effort, numerical limits, data retention, time and people; then only authorized signing can enable execution.
Stop on mismatch, unknown effects, expiry, revocation, missing custody/trust, breached cap, absent candidate for reuse, or loss of independent conditions.

stopAndContinue.repairScope: Development only; one exact artifact-bound correction. No unpriced retry of unknown creation, no evaluation-driven prompt tuning.
stopAndContinue.continuation: Report completed and blocked stages with actual receipts, unknown cost and unused limits. An additional request needs a concrete remaining task, evidence of decision value, exact bindings and new explicit authorization.
stopAndContinue.promotion: Baseline retained absent independently verified scoped improvement; unsupported transfer is rejected and observed failure triggers scoped rollback.
